summary: Practise SQL Server backups, permissions, Agent jobs and performance checks. Prepare for DBA administration topics. Explore the five-day course.
lede: SQL Server database administration covers routine instance checks, access control, backup and restore testing, and performance investigation. For foundation-level administrators and support analysts, the training focuses on carrying out and documenting routine SQL Server operations. You practise checking SQL Server Agent jobs, reviewing permissions, testing recovery, and investigating query performance with Query Store and execution plans.
audienceIntro: This course suits foundation-level learners preparing for database administration duties or certification topics who need repeatable procedures for SQL Server operations, recovery, security, and troubleshooting.
modules: SQL Server Change and Recovery Reporting
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with databases and routine computer use is helpful. No prior SQL Server administration experience or programming background is required; exercises use foundational T-SQL administration statements.
